notes: Commit 4c5634b fixes the four problems that held the last review at 8.1, and each fix shows in the fresh screenshots. (1) Clock: fixed. The tick is now setNow(n => n ? n + 1 : 0) on both the dashboard and the show page. timeLeft shows '…' until chainTime answers, so phone-booked-dashboard.png reads 'sales close in …' instead of '20735d'. (2) The story contradicting itself: mostly fixed. When devnet returns no events, Feed now builds lines from the show accounts ('Berlin: On sale: 80 fans so far.', 'Hamburg: Goes ahead: 240 fans so far.'), grouped into the usual categories with an explanatory note, and does this on both the dashboard (7-booked-dashboard.png) and Activity (phone-feed.png). The never-ending 'Reading the story…' text is gone. (3) Phone gap under the nav: fixed. phone-feed, phone-approvals and phone-planner now start the content right under the nav. (4) Units for agent-booked tours: fixed. describe() decodes a tickets/SOL text next to the fans/euros one, and Feed picks between them with inFans, which comes from run.inApp. Also fixed: Book cannot be tapped twice (busy is set first, and book() returns early while busy). Partly fixed: the show page's empty purchase table is replaced by one line, and the no-tour screen now puts the CTA first with the wallet panel under a 'Your wallet' heading. The journey a musician needs now works without visible bugs: a public pitch, one 'Create your first tour' button, four questions with defaults, the route and money shown before booking, a booked dashboard that says what waits on whom, a show page with 'Copy link for fans', and a nav that works on a phone. It still sits just under 8.5, because the friction left is spread across many screens. The booked dashboard now shows the same three shows five times: stepper, stat tiles, itinerary, Shows grid, and the new fallback feed (whose rows carry the current clock time as if they had just happened). The line under 'Book this tour' still leads with SOL, Band record still says 'Gross settled 0 SOL' and 'Tickets sold', and registration still mentions rent. The price box still clamps on every keystroke. Every tour starts in Berlin with unexplained days off. Booking a second tour still hides the running one. The planner overwrites the band's sketch with no undo. Phone Venues is still 10,500 px long, and Approvals stays in the nav as a page that only says there is nothing to approve.
issues: packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:207-230,326-420: the booked dashboard repeats the same three shows five times: stepper, five stat tiles, itinerary with badges, the Shows grid, and now the fallback 'What happened' rows ('Berlin: On sale: 80 fans so far' sits directly under the Berlin card). On a phone the route starts about 800 px down (phone-home.png is 2,500 px). The stepper also marks 'Venues signed' as the current step while a show is already confirmed. Fix: one summary line plus the itinerary, with each stop's progress inline and a tap to open the card; drop the Shows grid; hide the fallback feed on the dashboard (keep it on Activity) or show it only when real events exist.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:268-271: the line under 'Book this tour' still reads 'about 0.005 SOL per show' and '(that is 0.0003 SOL of devnet play money)' (4-route-preview.png), right where the band decides. Fix: 'Your wallet asks once and pays a small refundable deposit (under €1 in this demo)', with the SOL figures behind a 'Details' disclosure.

packages/web/src/app/band/page.tsx:70-91 + components/Connect.tsx:101,114,138 + components/WalletPanel.tsx:74-78 + app/page.tsx:469: the band record still shows 'Gross settled 0 SOL', 'Tickets sold' (a sample count) and 'profile ↗' (phone-band.png). Registration says 'registered on-chain' and 'a little rent (about 0.002 SOL)'. The wallet panel on both dashboards still lists 'Settled shows' and 'Tickets you hold: none', and the no-tour heading says 'Your band is on-chain.' Fix: 'Played shows', fans and euros for app tours, 'a small deposit', drop 'Tickets you hold' from the band view, and write 'You're set up. Time for the first tour.'

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:69-70 + app/tour/new/page.tsx:144: the wizard now honestly warns that 'the dashboard then follows the new tour' (phone-tour-new.png), but the running tour is still unreachable afterwards, because only toursCreated-1 is read. Fix: list earlier tours under the current one ('Running and past tours') with links, or keep the dashboard on the tour that still has live shows.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:20 + lib/book.ts (planFromAnswers): every band starts in Berlin, and the route cannot be changed. In 4-route-preview.png Berlin is followed by '4 days off' before a 179 km drive, and the route doubles back from Leipzig north to Hamburg, with no explanation and no way to drop a stop. Fix: remember the last start city, say why a gap exists ('no free room in Leipzig before Nov 8'), and allow per-stop toggles like the Approvals route card.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:229 + phone-venues.png: phone Venues is still one 10,508 px list of every city under two filter toolbars, and 'No venues match these filters.' offers no reset. Fix: collapse each city to one row that opens on tap, put the filters behind a single 'Filter' button on phones, and add 'Clear filters' to the empty state.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:179 (also app/show/page.tsx fan qty input): the custom price still clamps on every keystroke (Number('') || 1), so deleting '20' to type '35' gives 1 and then 13. The fan's quantity box behaves the same way. Fix: keep the raw string in state and clamp on blur or on Plan my tour / Buy.

packages/web/src/components/Feed.tsx:20-33,155,177: fallback lines are stamped at: Date.now() and rebuilt on every render, so every row shows the current time (08:16 AM in 7-booked-dashboard.png) as if it had just happened, and the time moves while the band watches. The note says the story 'loads from devnet when it answers', which is chain wording and never comes true on a quiet RPC. Fix: hide the time column for fallback rows (or label them 'now'), memoise the list, and write 'Where each show stands now. The full history appears when the network catches up.'

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:284: the band's show page now says 'No purchases read yet. They appear here as fans buy.' directly under '80 / 400 fans' (8-own-show.png), which still reads as a contradiction, and 'read' is chain wording. The Threshold tile wraps '= 200 / fans' onto two lines. Fix: '80 fans have bought so far; the list of buyers is not available on devnet', and label the tile 'Goes ahead at: 200 fans (50%)'.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:112-134: 'Open in route planner →' (?from=tour) still overwrites the band's saved sketch through savePlan, and the planner reschedules with its own rest rule, so the dates differ from the dashboard. 'Load my tour' and 'Clear' wipe the plan with no undo. Fix: keep the tour's real days, and add an undo toast.

packages/web/src/components/Shell.tsx:17-24 + components/Approvals.tsx:390: Approvals stays a permanent nav item for bands that booked in the wizard, whose page only says there is nothing to approve (phone-approvals.png), and the agent flow still says 'The offer lapses in about 287s'. Fix: show Approvals in the nav only while something is pending or for agent-run bands, and format the countdown as '~5 min'.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:256-290: on the booked dashboard the three header actions 'New tour / Plan a route / Track record' have equal weight, and 'New tour' comes first while the current tour is still selling, so the screen has no single obvious next step. On a phone they take two rows above the content. Fix: while a tour runs, make the status banner the focus and put the actions into one quiet 'More' menu, or show only 'Track record' and 'Plan a route' as text links.

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:248,410-445: the phone sweep still never captures the wizard's route preview after Plan my tour or the band's own show page at 390 px. The fake RPC still returns [] for getSignaturesForAddress, so only the fallback feed is ever exercised, never real band events in fans and euros or tickets and SOL. Fix: add /tour/new after Plan my tour and /show?address=… to the phone sweep, and return a few signed events from the fake RPC.
